target.name: Annual canopy-loss fraction within a predefined forest mask
target.intended_use: Compare future annual canopy-loss forecasts on protected regions and dates

_instructions: Template for scripts/benchmark_references.py, NOT the health trajectory head. Supply at least 10/5/5 real examples for train/calibration/test (software minima only). Annual loss-year data have no exact event day and cannot justify day-level warning lead time. Match cutoff/target dates to the configured day horizon; leap-year windows require their actual horizon. Features and baselines must be available by cutoff. Do not derive labels from the same index threshold being evaluated.
